name: tou_away_cool_bank_range_thermostat_1404
description: Issue #1404 (range thermostats): the #1395 Away cool bank on a thermostat that offers heat_cool with a temperature range and starts in heat_cool. The bank and every surface behave as on a single-setpoint device. CA switches the device out of heat_cool to cool and writes a single setpoint (77 F), so the range-only hold check (target_temp_low/high without a temperature attribute) is not exercised here; that path is covered by tests/test_current_hold_1404.py.

assertions.reason: A heat/cool-range thermostat in heat_cool: the bank still writes cool 77 F once.
No re-send between cycles: the 5-minute check reads the range device as holding the bank.
The thresholds quote the bank on a range thermostat too.

assertions.value: pre-cooling to 77°F until the 4:15 PM high-cost period, then the Away band widened to 60–83°F until 9:00 PM
assertions.reason: Same sentence as a single-setpoint thermostat.

verdict.summary: A heat/cool-range thermostat gets the same bank and the same story
verdict.observed_behavior: Issue #1404 (range thermostats): the #1395 Away cool bank on a thermostat that offers heat_cool with a temperature range and starts in heat_cool. The bank and every surface behave as on a single-setpoint device.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: on a thermostat that offers a heat/cool range, every surface quotes the bank target the thermostat is told, exactly as on a single-setpoint device.
verdict.effectiveness: Fails on 6ebdb16: thresholds 60/80 and no hold block. Deleting the display resolver fails both field_equals rows.
verdict.user_outcome: If this regressed, a range-thermostat owner would read 'Climate Advisor wants 80 F' while it cools to 77 F.
